definitions.contentMs: page performance.now() at the first visible match of the content selector (MutationObserver); 0 = navigation start (cold/warm) or the click (start)
definitions.apiDepth: sequential waves among API requests until the content: wave = 1 + highest wave of the API requests that had finished before it started
definitions.depthWithChunks: same rule over document + JS chunks + API requests served from the network (cache hits excluded) until the content; an upper bound
definitions.secondary: attempt-result only: same metrics until the overall AI feedback section is visible (full useful content of a published result)
definitions.warm: second full visit (page.goto) of the same URL in the same browser context: HTTP cache warm, SWR memory cache empty
definitions.start: client-side navigation intro → player by clicking Continuar intento/Comenzar (idempotent start endpoint), measured to the first question
definitions.autosave: pick another option of question 1: clickToPutStartMs includes the client debounce; putMs = PUT duration on the network; clickToSavedMs = click → status line shows the saved text again
